reason: ₹22,000 is more than a month and a half of what my family earns, and even ₹2,000 a month for a year is too much when my wife still washes by hand for free. If I buy something this big it will be at Diwali or after harvest, with a discount or a gift, not in an ordinary week.
objection: Who will repair it in my village, and what will a new battery cost when this one dies after three years? The dealer is in town, and if he does not come, I am stuck with a dead machine I am still paying EMI on.
would_change_my_mind: A Diwali or harvest offer that brings it near ₹15,000 with the solar panel free, plus a written promise that the dealer's mechanic comes to my village for repairs and a fixed price for the replacement battery.
